module.name: ibm_roks_cluster_create
module.description: Create an IBM ROKS cluster using an existing COS instance for the registry and emit BNK cluster-registration outputs.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key used to provision the cluster.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region where the ROKS cluster will be created.

required.name: roks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the IBM ROKS cluster to create.

required.name: ibmcloud_cos_instance_name
required.description: Name of the existing IBM COS instance used for the registry.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group for the cluster and COS lookup. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: workers_per_zone
optional.description: Worker node count per zone. OpenShift clusters typically require at least 2 workers per zone.

optional.name: min_worker_vcpu_count
optional.description: Minimum vCPU count used for worker flavor selection.

optional.name: min_worker_memory_gb
optional.description: Minimum worker memory in GB used for worker flavor selection.

optional.name: cluster_vpc_cidr
optional.description: Base CIDR for the created cluster VPC.

key_outputs.name: cluster_id
key_outputs.description: Cluster ID alias for BNK cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: cluster_name
key_outputs.description: Cluster name alias for BNK cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: cluster_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Cluster API endpoint alias for BNK cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: openshift_cluster_public_endpoint
key_outputs.description: Cluster API endpoint used by BNK managed-cluster registration.

key_outputs.name: region
key_outputs.description: IBM Cloud region for the cluster.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud credential template or project secret providing the API key.
